d:
Something to celebrate HSR's 3rd Anniversary and Silver Wolf Lv.999. God her body is so hot.

Gonna be honest, I'm not sure I'll do the sequels because this was way too much for me to clean and redraw. For the most part, this was just to time it with Silver Wolf Lv.999. I don't think I'm particularly good enough at it, so it took me like a month to clean and redraw this with only like 16 pages. I suppose I'm maybe open to working on them collaboratively if someone wants to CL/RD, but there's also a bunch of other doujins I wanna work on, so we'll see how things go.
